title: Keep draft review responsive for large cluster runs
description:
As a curator opening a large draft over the LAN, I want the review page to show usable clusters promptly so that I can begin listening without the browser becoming unresponsive.

Feature: progressive draft review

Scenario: opening a large draft
Given a draft contains hundreds of clusters
When its review page opens
Then the page renders an initial bounded set of clusters
And offers a deliberate control to reveal additional clusters
And approval remains unavailable until every current representative has been reviewed.

Scope: review-page rendering only; no change to membership, labels, or publication semantics.
right_now_summary: The review page will load clusters in batches while keeping approval gated until all representatives are reviewed.
